decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8903. Series context: trend strength 0.8481 and seasonal strength 0.0633; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.072); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.756.
